9.9.1
Com Grant Deployment
[TPS_MANI_01237]{DRAFT} Semantics of meta-class ComFieldGrant ⌈Meta-
class ComFieldGrant shall be used to award access to a given field (identified
by means of the reference to meta-class ServiceFieldDeployment in the role
serviceDeployment) in the context of a given AdaptivePlatformServiceIn-
stance referenced in the role serviceInstance.⌋(RS_MANI_00060)
In other words, if a given AdaptivePlatformServiceInstance and the respec-
tive ServiceFieldDeployment are not referenced from a ComFieldGrant and
an IamModuleInstantiation exists then this specific communication shall be
suppressed.
